result.summary: The Draft Copilot was a small local web application designed to assist users during a 12-team, full-PPR snake fantasy football draft on Sleeper. Its main goal was to provide recommendations based on expert consensus rankings rather than Sleeper's standard ADP.

key_points.fact: The Draft Copilot was a small local web app.
The goal was a tool to use during a 12-team, full-PPR snake draft on Sleeper.
Recommendations should come from expert consensus rankings, not Sleeper's ADP.
The default rankings blend FantasyPros consensus and ESPN Field Yates PPR rankings.
A player on both lists gets FantasyPros_rank × 0.6 + ESPN_rank × 0.4.
The app fetches picks every 3 seconds.
The scarcity formula is scarcity = POS_SLOPE[pos] × (REPLACEMENT_RANK[pos] − position_rank).
The fix for the 'My Team' empty issue was to identify picks by `draft_slot`, which is set in both mock and real drafts.
Check for an API before building scraping or screenshot reading.

facts.fact: The Draft Copilot was a small local web app.
The Draft Copilot ran alongside a live Sleeper fantasy football draft.
The goal was a tool to use during a 12-team, full-PPR snake draft on Sleeper.
Recommendations should come from expert consensus rankings, not Sleeper's ADP.
The Screenshot app was rejected because reading text from images is unreliable.
The Live companion turned out to be the easier option.
The default rankings blend FantasyPros consensus and ESPN Field Yates PPR rankings.
A player on both lists gets FantasyPros_rank × 0.6 + ESPN_rank × 0.4.
The app fetches picks every 3 seconds.
Sleeper's CDN caches the picks endpoint for up to 30 seconds.
The value model adds position scarcity as a secondary nudge.
The scarcity formula is scarcity = POS_SLOPE[pos] × (REPLACEMENT_RANK[pos] − position_rank).

facts.section: The Value Model > How the model evolved
facts.fact: The first version used `replacement_rank − position_rank` alone.

facts.section: The Value Model > How the model evolved
facts.fact: This first version answered the 2.10 question by favoring the RB11 over the TE1, but it let scarcity override real differences in talent.
The 'My Team' empty issue was caused by Sleeper leaving `roster_id` null on mock-draft picks.
The fix for the 'My Team' empty issue was to identify picks by `draft_slot`, which is set in both mock and real drafts.

Test on a mock draft before relying on the app live.
